title: Hindsight Reviewer mandate omitted the offered review bundle from its variable binding
surface: Existing hindsight.reviewer mandate evidence provisioning for D273 quality review
auth_mode: internal existing-account system mandate; no guest product-mode result
severity: S2: contained quality review returned an empty-evidence answer despite a supplied bundle; no product data loss or Chat defect established
priority: P1: unblock evidence-grounded contained review before quality Builder work
preconditions: Existing hindsight.reviewer holder 9bc0924d-9995-41ed-b00c-09e9cf9101f1 pinned to version ad6074af-3d54-4c5b-bec7-879c15a338b1.
A 27723-character review_bundle was offered for the D273 real failed and successful cases; default_consumption_map was null.
reproduction: Initial mandate-path review completed but its two provider snapshots omitted the exact H1 and failed case ID; reviewer reported no operational evidence. Its saved tools=[] did not prevent one read-only scope overview.
Direct variables.bundle positive control contained the heading and failed case ID with zero tools, localizing the missing evidence to mandate consumption.
expected: The mandate maps offered review_bundle into reviewer variable bundle so the existing reviewer can evaluate the supplied real cases.
actual: Two initial mandate provider snapshots lacked the offered bundle, producing an empty-evidence terminal review.
cause: The existing mandate default had no consumption map for the offered review_bundle, so the guaranteed provision did not land in reviewer variable bundle.
fix: Supported PUT to the same hindsight.reviewer default-holder set only default_consumption_map.bundle to mapType offered_value, target review_bundle, deliver variable. Same holder and pinned version remained; config overrides and auto-run stayed null.
verification_status: Repaired mandate-run event shows offered review_bundle supplied and landed in variable bundle; fresh peer readback of provider snapshot 1862c26e-dea8-4428-b2e3-0a1640c529f0 includes exact H1 and failed case ID, completed request 54450cfa-86ff-4167-962a-57a26762b779 with zero tools. Fresh peer Verdict A PASS and B PASS_FOR_BINDING_SCOPE. This closes the internal binding prerequisite only; D273 remains triaged and no native case gets credit.

transition_history.reason: First contained reviewer response falsely reported no bundle despite 27723 offered characters; exact discovery time not retained in source report.
Two provider snapshots omitted heading/case while direct variables.bundle positive control included both; exact triage time not retained.
Supported same-holder/same-version consumption-map repair selected; exact start time not retained.
Live mandate contract check recorded repaired bundle mapping; no holder/version advance.
Later repaired mandate request/provider readback and fresh independent A/B peer pass. Peer report did not retain exact readback timestamp; date only recorded.
Binding prerequisite alone verified. D273 guest product behavior remains triaged/unfixed; no native acceptance credit. Exact closure time not retained.

dependency_note: D275 supplies a working contained reviewer for D273. Reviewer extractor-defect claim is rejected as unproven; supported DOM verification behavior is a quality candidate, not applied. Real browser-capable Builder proof set and existing-agent process remain open.
